topic: Deploying session tracking services to production
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on deploying updated session tracking components. Initial concerns were raised regarding how recent commits might affect data integrity, particularly for the 'factor' system and its use of real-time data.

After troubleshooting and fixing the build, it was determined that only `sessioner-seen` needed to be deployed to production via kube-web, as this component handles session creation based on 'seen' events and feeds real-time data into AFA. The `sessioner` component is not required for deployment at this time.
decisions: Deploy only the `sessioner-seen` service to production.
The deployment will be executed via kube-web.
